sentences.text:
This application coming on for hearing this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER
This is fourth bail application u/S.439 Cr.P.C filed by the applicant for grant of bail.
His first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn on 10/02/2022 passed in M.Cr.C. No.6411/2022.
His second bail application was dismissed on merits on 04/08/2022 passed in M.Cr.C. No.37972/2022.

His third bail application was dismissed on mertis on 11/10/2022 passed in M.Cr.C.
No.44575/2022.

Applicant has been arrested on 24.12.2021 by Police Station- Kumbhraj, District Guna (MP), in connection with Crime No.299/2021 for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 306, 376 of IPC,
Section 3(1)(w)(ii), 3(2)(v) of SC/ST Act and Section 3, 4, 11, 12 of POCSO Act.

sentences.text: In brief case of the prosecution is that on 09/12/2021 at about 5:58 p.m., the father of prosecutrix namely, Bharat Singh lodged a missing report regarding his daughter aged about 15 years that she has been missing from 08/12/2021.
He is having doubt that present applicant/accused persuaded her to go with him.
On his information, missing report bearing no.05/2021 at crime no.299/2021 has been registered at Police Station Kumbhraj, District Guna.

On 10/12/2021 due to consumption of poisonous substance, the prosecutrix was brought to district hospital Guna wherein, her statements were recorded in which, she has stated that she is studying in 10th standard.
She loves the present applicant/accused.
Two days back, she alongwith present applicant/accused came to Byavra by bus.
Thereafter, went to Indore and stayed in a hotel at night.
When they were coming back from Indore, she called her father by telephone.

She has further stated that near Sarangpur,
she and present applicant consumed Salfas.
The present applicant brought the Salfas pills from Indore.
On coming home, family members scold, due to this fear, she and present applicant had consumed the Salfas pills.
Thereafter, her father take her Byavra to Beenaganj hospital and lastly District Hospital Guna.
She has further stated that she had gone with present applicant on her own will.
Present applicant had not committed anything forcefully with her.
During treatment, she died.
Dead body Panchnama was prepared.
Dying-declaration was also recorded in which she has not alleged anything against the present applicant.
As post-mortem, she died due to consumption of poisonous substance.
As per FSL report, human sperm was found on her vaginal slides and clothes.

On the basis of aforesaid, the offence punishable under Sections 363, 306, 376 of IPC, Section 3(1)(w)(ii), 3(2)(v) of SC/ST Act and Section 3, 4, 11, 12 of POCSO Act has been registered against the present applicant.

New ground raised in present bail application is that after rejection of third bail application on 11/10/2022, the statement of father, mother and brother of the proesecutrix have been recorded on 02/12/2022, 16/12/2022 and 10/01/2023 respectively.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the case.
Applicant is in custody since 24/12/2021.
After investigation, chargesheet has been submitted and therefore, further custodial intrrogation is no more required.
Conclusion of trial will take time.
The applicant is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions as may be imposed by this Court.
With the aforesaid submissions, prayer for grant of bail is made.
Learned counsel for the State vehemently opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for both the parties and perused the case diary.

Looking to the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and coupled with fact that the proesecutrix had not alleged anything against the present applicant before her death, without commenting upon the merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the application it is ordered that if the applicant furnishes a cash security of Rs.25,000/- alongwith a personal bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees twenty five thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, he should be released on bail.
He will present during trial before the trial Court on each and every date.
In case of any default, cash security of Rs.25,000/- shall be forfeited without giving any notice.
